power: Latest explicit operator confirmation OFF and sticks neutral. Fresh A powered readiness required before any CAN lifecycle.

recovery: Close wire window; stop sole writer; fresh zero feedback150ms plus one fresh frame within1s; detach; zero-SDO/Disable Voltage and volatile restore. Any failure ends trial, no automatic retry; operator emergency stop/OFF.
startup: JCAN silent capture then target candump, fresh readiness, one-shot marker; no automatic retry
changed_condition: New user authorization after R0 review. Hold input through automatic cutoff; capture raw input and explicit cause. R0 natural return generated right-negative candidates; no return stimulus while motion is active. Guard rejects any opposite or negative command unchanged.
operator_sequence: Neutral sticks/CH6 released; CONTROL_READY: press/release CH6 once, remain neutral. MOTION_READY: push forward/right smoothly together and HOLD until STOP_VERIFIED (or confirmed application exit); then neutral.
